events.action: {"message": "Fixed the off-by-one loop condition in `fcb_new_sector()` in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/subsys/fs/fcb/fcb_append.c` (`while (i++ < cnt)` instead of `while (i++ <= cnt)`). Previously, the loop checked one extra sector beyond the required `cnt` scratch sectors, preventing `fcb_new_sector` from allocating the last non-scratch sector when `cnt` was satisfied. All FCB tests now build and pass on `native_sim`.", "kind": "FinishAction"}
